company_positioning.category: AI execution layer for bounded asynchronous work
company_positioning.primary_audience: Software companies, integrators and organisations with document work to improve
company_positioning.promise: AI document processing. Clarity on quality and cost.
company_positioning.partner_message: You keep the customer and workflow. Solvyr handles the agreed AI processing.
company_positioning.capacity_principle: Workload demand comes before capacity expansion; the result contract stays stable as approved compute changes underneath.
company_positioning.first_route: Document intake before downstream ERP or operations workflows
company_positioning.worker_mechanism: Lightweight workers pull bounded tasks from the scheduler, execute them locally, and return status and results.
intended_capacity_routes: explicitly approved customer and partner machines
European GPU providers for overflow and workload-specific capacity
company_positioning.pricing_boundary: Lower total cost is the aim, assessed per task at the required quality, including human review and operating effort.
company_positioning.deployment_boundary: Managed execution is the starting point. Customer hardware and specific placement are assessed and agreed for each task; they are not universal current availability claims.
company_positioning.european_direction: Solvyr is building a European AI execution layer. Control is made concrete through workload-specific agreements on processing location, access and retention.

classification: AI data preparation and corpus operations
header_tagline: Fast Corpus for European AI teams
summary: Clean PDF and text backlogs to AI-ready JSONL with extracted text, chunks, embeddings, stable IDs, and an inspectable run report at a predictable starting unit price. Adjacent scoped use cases include recurring public-data quality runs over public or test metadata exports.
positioning: Customers buy completed corpus output and run evidence, not GPU-hours, API/CLI access, an orchestration layer, or a platform project.
build_vs_buy_positioning: A team can build and operate its own extraction, chunking, embedding, queueing, retry, and reporting pipeline, or buy a completed Fast Corpus run. Solvyr customers do not provision workers, operate queues, or assemble the pipeline.
cost_positioning: Cost-effective backlog processing with a scoped run, price per processed page, and a decision based on inspected output. The published starting unit covers standard clean processing; complete engagements also reflect validation, output, execution-boundary, and operational-responsibility requirements.
api_cli_positioning: API/CLI language is integration or handoff context, not the primary public offer.
european_sovereignty_positioning: European execution control and sovereignty are relevant for archives, public-sector teams, research networks, and EU/NL connectors when tied to a real document backlog and pilot decision.
broader_system: Controlled distributed execution for async AI workloads with central scheduling, bounded tasks, retries, visible outcomes, and completed work rather than raw capacity rental.
vision: Build a European AI execution network that grows approved compute behind real workload demand.
mission: Make a schedulable portion of distributed hardware dependable for suitable AI work through controlled, inspectable execution.
current_wedge: Document intake is the current customer entry; Fast Corpus remains the dedicated document-to-corpus offer and demonstrated processing path.
geographic_direction: Europe is the first proving ground for explicit location, ownership, policy, and evidence, not the geographic ceiling.
vision_claim_boundary: Better hardware utilization, resilience, energy-aware scheduling, and reduced pressure on central infrastructure are intended outcomes that require measurement. Current proof does not demonstrate lower electricity or water use, lower emissions, less data-centre construction, certified sovereignty, or greater efficiency than data-centre GPUs. Distributed execution is not automatically more efficient.
expansion_path: Fast Corpus is the first bounded workload. Repeated corpus and document workflows exercise reusable workload contracts, scheduling, node eligibility, retries, visible state, result validation, and lifecycle reporting before additional bounded async AI workloads are offered.
execution_pool_positioning: Suitable async work currently begins with Solvyr-controlled infrastructure. Explicitly approved partner- or customer-controlled workers and European GPU providers are intended pool classes, not current broad availability.

direct_answers.what_is_solvyr: AI document processing and a supported AI result layer. Start with example documents and a task, test quality and processing costs, then agree the next step. Partners keep the customer and workflow.
direct_answers.is_solvyr_a_gpu_provider: No. Customers buy supported, checked results; controlled distributed execution is Solvyr's delivery engine rather than a raw GPU offer.
direct_answers.is_solvyr_an_orchestration_layer: Solvyr builds an AI execution layer, but does not sell generic compute orchestration. The buyer receives a supported, checked result rather than a scheduler, container platform, or GPU-hour.
direct_answers.what_is_fast_corpus: The managed document-to-corpus route for digital PDF and text backlogs, with its own standard-processing starting rate.
direct_answers.what_fast_corpus_delivers: Extracted text, AI-ready JSONL, chunks, embeddings, stable IDs, caveats, and an inspectable run report.
direct_answers.how_to_start: Describe your documents and intended result. Agree representative examples, then assess quality, human review and processing costs.
direct_answers.how_to_start_fast_corpus: Describe the corpus you need, then test representative examples before agreeing a batch or recurring refresh.

document_intake.offer: Bring example documents and the intended task; test output quality and processing costs before agreeing recurring use.
tasks_to_scope: matching to customer records or catalogues
document_intake.delivery: Agreed fields and source references, with items requiring review made clear; the customer or workflow partner keeps approvals and downstream actions.
document_intake.capability_boundary: These are tasks Solvyr undertakes to investigate and build into the agreed route. Quality, formats, integrations and deployment are established on the representative sample; published corpus benchmarks remain evidence for their measured paths.
document_intake.comparison: Compare at equivalent useful quality, including human checking, correction and operating costs.
